text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both flat to slightly down, with Bitcoin holding firm at $80k despite minor pullback, while Ethereum's stability above $2.3k suggests steady demand for the larger altcoin. The Fear & Greed index at 48 (neutral, weakening from -7 over a week) and elevated Bitcoin dominance of 59.4% point to cautious sentiment—traders rotating toward safety rather than risk-on appetite. Volume at $66B is moderate, consistent with a consolidation phase rather than panic selling or explosive buying.
